notes.title: The Summer Postcard Festival is live!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I'm very excited to announce that [b]My Tiny Landscape is part of the [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ancientforge/sale/summerpostcard"]Summer Postcard Event[/url] organized by the Ancient Forge Team. The event runs [b]from September 22nd to 29th[/b]! This is a perfect opportunity to [b]play the demo[/b] and build the cute landscapes you have seen or dreamed about this summer! Whether you enjoy the polar climate with icy biomes and large taigas, or more tropical places like mangroves and savannas... Whether you carefully strategize to maximize your score or just want to enjoy a chill and relaxing gaming session, My Tiny Landscape has you covered![/p][p]I hope you will have a great time with the demo! [b]If you have feedback or suggestions, please share them on the Steam forums! Also, if you enjoy the game, be sure to wishlist and spread the word![/b] Much to my dismay, the game is still sitting on very low numbers of wishlists, so any help will be greatly appreciated![/p][p]Have a great festival![/p][p][i]-Radiant Sloth[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ancientforge/sale/summerpostcard][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/92fe2d36b762538e5a5f5865da3919fbc307bda0.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: More quality of life improvements for the demo!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Once again, I got great feedback from people giving the demo a try, thanks a lot! I implemented another batch of [b]quality of life improvements[/b] to address the suggestions made, and [b]it is now live on the demo[/b]! Please feel free to give your opinion on these changes on the Steam forums, or even suggest new things I could improve.[/p][p]As always, the full changelgog is below, with a few screenshots to illustrate the changes. I hope you will enjoy these additions.[/p][p]Also, people have started playing My Tiny Landscape on YouTube, and it is a ton of fun watching them, so check out their playthroughs![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uGuQTorRCgU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]See you next time,[/p][p][i]Radiant Sloth[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo v0.6h[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Can now inspect items when choosing a biome pack (by hovering with mouse, or using the inventory scrolling inputs for controller)[/p][/*][*][p]Building mode shows some altitude markers for items that have scoring rules related to it[/p][/*][*][p]When picking a pack or menhir, can now delay the choice and view the world again before making a decision [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reorganized the info panel of items[/p][list][*][p]Clearer  and more space-efficient display of scoring rules[/p][/*][*][p]Added info about the range[/p][/*][*][p]Better wording for some effects[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Clarified in tutorial that scoring is not retroactive, only the item being placed gives points[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Prevented inventory scrolling with the controller inputs when picking a pack[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/b9d725a4610000c76e1af3be3a3de2c198e8aa2c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/ac70513d89b6c5926ecfec3d57b22884408fc3a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/13bec3e086d84528748896dcea1bb6572d2f61b3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/633eca937dd3231166be9379254eaf0c0fa9106f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/2990e1106f95f2001b1e76d5545ffdf10c88a823.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Quality of life improvements and a tutorial for the demo!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I'm happy to share that [b]the demo of My Tiny Landscape just got an update[/b]! It adds a [b]tutorial[/b] to help players jump into the game more easily, as well as some [b]quality of life improvements[/b]. You will find the full changelog below. Don't hesitate to give your feedback on these changes on the Steam forums, or even suggest other improvements you'd like to see in the game![/p][p]See you next time,[/p][p][i]Radiant Sloth[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo v0.6f[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]In building mode, tiles where placing is possible are now highlighted[/p][/*][*][p]When choosing a menhir, the panels now show additional information about the special terraforming tools involved[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the world options so that maps with a large islands size have a more continental look[/p][/*][*][p]When choosing the world options and tweaking the world size, the camera now automatically zoom in and out to help better see the whole shape of the world[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a general tutorial, as well as some specific info notices for menhirs and the word options[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new action to locate remaining wasteland tiles (default is Space, Xbox X button, or clicking the cleansing progress text)[/p][/*][*][p]Added an accessibility option to give a special highlight to tiles that give the best scoring when in building mode[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed building mode remaining activated when picking a pack or triggering the end of a game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/f90418bd5800364de6f6a7840e9c2ea0a4082b22.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Play the Demo Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I am happy to share that [b]the Demo of My Tiny Landscape is out now on Steam[/b]! It is a minimalist relaxing landscape builder where you regrow barren archipelagos by placing biomes, tile by tile. You can either lean on the strategy side and carefully plan your moves to make the best out of the placement rules, or simply enjoy a peaceful and relaxing experience.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you will have fun discovering the demo! As always, please share your feedback on the Steam forums, this helps me a lot to fix issues and improve the game mechanics. I have not started working on the content for the full game yet, so I am very interested in hearing your suggestions. I want to make sure the core gameplay is as refined and enjoyable as possible![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586786/3b56229b2fa4f7b3e64cf888685b71e772c8dee2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support, and see you next time![/p][p][i]-Radiant Sloth[/i][/p]

notes.title: Announcing My Tiny Landscape!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43813655/b98dc89f7ed969285d10ba44fe39cc34701e7d70.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

It has been a few weeks since the release of Comet Force, and I am happy to announce my new upcoming project!

After working mainly on twin-stick shooter roguelikes, I wanted to explore something a bit different. Namely I wanted to work on non-violent gameplay. I wanted a project that incorporates strategy but also provides a relaxing experience and inspires respect for nature. So what about making a minimalist landscape builder? Something that feels like a crossover between Islanders and Terra Nil? This idea tickled my brain for a few years, but I was unable to come up with a satisfying prototype at the time. And so my attention shifted to other projects. But with Comet Force done, I felt it was time to finally tackle this challenge and turn this idea into a real game.

And so, here we are today. I am so happy to present [i][b]My Tiny Landscape[/b][/i], a minimalist colorful landscape builder! As you are presented with a procedurally generated barren archipelago, your goal is to regrow a vibrant landscape, tile by tile! Are you interested by the strategical aspect? Think carefully about every more and leverage placement rules to make the highest score! Or are you just looking for a relaxing and peaceful experience? Just unleash your creativity and watch your tiny landscape slowly getting back to life!

I'll dive more into the mechanics in future posts, so let's just watch a preview trailer for today! If you like what you see, please [u][b]wishlist the game[/b][/u] to support my work and not miss any important news! I plan to release a public demo in a couple weeks, so wishlisting is the best way to make sure Steam notifies you when it comes out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HFBYZUS2T_g

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655260/My_Tiny_Landscape

As always, thanks for reading, and see you soon for more posts about My Tiny Landscape!

[i]-Radiant Sloth[/i]
